en-US.title: Jump Start a Dead Car with a Drill Battery
en-US.description:
Can you really jump-start a dead car with a power drill battery? The answer is YES—it actually works!

In this video, I’m putting this famous emergency hack to the ultimate test. If you’ve ever found yourself stranded with a dead battery and no jumper cables, this method could be a total lifesaver. I’ll walk you through the entire process from start to finish to show you how to get your engine roaring back to life.

Here is the step-by-step breakdown of how I did it:

Step 1: The Prep – I picked up some standard electrical wire from the hardware store to create a bridge between the batteries.

Step 2: Voltage Check – My car battery was sitting at 11.8V, which wasn't enough to crank the engine.

Step 3: The Setup – I connected the drill battery to the car battery, making sure to match the positive (+) and negative (-) terminals carefully for a safe charge.

Step 4: The Boost – Once the voltage climbed to a solid 13V, it was time for the moment of truth.

Step 5: Ignition Success – One turn of the key and the engine started perfectly!

⚠️ WARNING: This is an emergency hack for survival situations. Always be careful with polarities and battery safety.

#jumpstart #carhack #diy
